name: aggregates-min5
description: Draft for maintainer review. Every count and person count is at least 5 or null, so no cell singles out one to four persons. A statistic rests on at least 50 persons (5 per decile group, as the mock-stats policy), so no decile or coarser quantile is one person's value; finer quantiles and extremes are the reviewer's to refuse. A double statistic has at most 3 significant digits, which narrows the bits an unsuppressed value can carry to about 10. No dominance, secondary suppression or count rounding: format 1 has none, and the reviewer covers them.
